title: dam secrets.lua
description: The table secrets.lua returns, read from the folder that holds config.lua. A Lua list is an array here and a table of named entries is an object. The top level refuses an unknown key; a token table is read leniently, so a bad token is disabled or skipped rather than stopping dam.

schema.description: Governs only the token tables. A value other than 1 disables every token.

remote.description: Credentials by remote. Each remote must be declared in config.lua.

additionalProperties.description: A credential: a string, or a function that returns one. dam calls the function only when the remote is used.

token.description: An unknown key or a non-empty limits table disables the token.

grant.description: An unknown permission in allow is skipped with a warning.
